name: opentape
description: A small, free, open-source screen recorder for macOS.
author: Aidan McAlister

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && eslint . && prettier --check src && bun test ./src && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --quiet && git diff --exit-code --stat -- ../src/lib/bindings.ts
scripts.dmg:preview: for n in 1 2; do "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless=new --hide-scrollbars --force-device-scale-factor=$n --window-size=660,400 --screenshot=$TMPDIR/dmg-bg$n.png "file://$PWD/src-tauri/icons/dmg-background.html" >/dev/null 2>&1; sips -s dpiWidth $((72*n)) -s dpiHeight $((72*n)) $TMPDIR/dmg-bg$n.png >/dev/null; done && tiffutil -cathidpicheck $TMPDIR/dmg-bg1.png $TMPDIR/dmg-bg2.png -out src-tauri/icons/dmg-background.tiff && tauri bundle --bundles app,dmg && open src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg
